questions.question: Redux là gì và tại sao cần?

options.B: Redux: predictable state container cho JS apps — single store, unidirectional data flow; useful khi many components share state, state changes phức tạp, time-travel debugging cần
options.C: Redux là required cho mọi React app

questions.explanation: Redux core: (1) Single store — tất cả app state trong 1 object tree. (2) State is read-only — chỉ dispatch actions để thay đổi. (3) Pure reducers — (state, action) => newState, no side effects. Redux Toolkit (RTK) — official recommended way. createSlice: combine actions + reducer. configureStore: setup store với DevTools, middleware. Khi nên dùng: nhiều unrelated components cần same state, deep prop drilling, complex state updates. Khi KHÔNG nên: small apps, local UI state (modal, form input).

questions.question: Redux Toolkit createSlice hoạt động thế nào?

options.B: createSlice tự động generate action creators và action types từ reducer functions; sử dụng Immer internally nên có thể 'mutate' state trực tiếp

questions.explanation: const counterSlice = createSlice({ name: 'counter', initialState: { value: 0 }, reducers: { increment: (state) => { state.value++ }, // Immer! decrement: (state) => { state.value-- }, incrementByAmount: (state, action: PayloadAction<number>) => { state.value += action.payload } } }). export const { increment, decrement, incrementByAmount } = counterSlice.actions; export default counterSlice.reducer. Immer: cho phép viết 'mutating' code nhưng thực ra tạo new state. Auto-generates: 'counter/increment', 'counter/decrement' action types.

questions.question: RTK Query là gì và tại sao dùng?

options.B: RTK Query: data fetching và caching solution tích hợp trong RTK — tự động generate hooks (useGetUsersQuery, useCreateUserMutation), cache management, background refetch
options.C: Phải dùng redux-thunk thay RTK Query
options.D: RTK Query chỉ cho REST APIs

questions.explanation: const apiSlice = createApi({ reducerPath: 'api', baseQuery: fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: '/api' }), tagTypes: ['Users'], endpoints: (builder) => ({ getUsers: builder.query<User[], void>({ query: () => 'users', providesTags: ['Users'] }), createUser: builder.mutation<User, CreateUserDto>({ query: (user) => ({ url: 'users', method: 'POST', body: user }), invalidatesTags: ['Users'] }) }) }). const { data, isLoading, error } = useGetUsersQuery(). Cache invalidation với tags: khi createUser → invalidate 'Users' tag → getUsers refetch. Replaces: redux-thunk boilerplate, manual loading/error state.

questions.question: useSelector và useDispatch — cách dùng đúng?

options.B: useSelector: subscribe và select từ store (re-render khi selected value thay đổi); useDispatch: get dispatch function để send actions; TypeScript typed versions

questions.explanation: const count = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.counter.value). Shallow equality: useSelector mặc định === comparison → re-render khi reference thay đổi. shallowEqual: useSelector(selectMultipleFields, shallowEqual) — tránh re-renders không cần thiết. Typed hooks (recommended): export const useAppSelector: TypedUseSelectorHook<RootState> = useSelector; export const useAppDispatch = () => useDispatch<AppDispatch>. Dispatch: const dispatch = useAppDispatch(); dispatch(increment()). Performance: selector functions nên stable (đặt ngoài component), dùng createSelector cho derived data.

questions.question: createAsyncThunk — xử lý async actions trong Redux?

options.B: createAsyncThunk: tạo async action creator với pending/fulfilled/rejected lifecycle; extraReducers trong createSlice để handle từng state

questions.explanation: const fetchUsers = createAsyncThunk('users/fetchAll', async (_, { rejectWithValue }) => { try { const response = await fetch('/api/users'); return await response.json(); } catch (err) { return rejectWithValue(err.message); } }). extraReducers trong slice: extraReducers: (builder) => { builder.addCase(fetchUsers.pending, (state) => { state.loading = true }) .addCase(fetchUsers.fulfilled, (state, action) => { state.loading = false; state.data = action.payload }) .addCase(fetchUsers.rejected, (state, action) => { state.loading = false; state.error = action.payload }) }. RTK Query replaces thunk cho most data fetching.

questions.question: createSelector (Reselect) — memoized selectors?

options.B: createSelector: compose selectors với memoization — chỉ recompute khi inputs thay đổi; tốt cho expensive derivations, tránh re-renders

questions.explanation: const selectTodos = (state: RootState) => state.todos.items; const selectFilter = (state: RootState) => state.todos.filter; const selectFilteredTodos = createSelector([selectTodos, selectFilter], (todos, filter) => { // This only runs when todos or filter change return todos.filter(todo => filter === 'all' || todo.status === filter); }). Component: const filteredTodos = useAppSelector(selectFilteredTodos). Memoization: giữ previous result, chỉ recalculate khi inputs (===) thay đổi. Multiple instances: createSelector(...) nếu cần per-component instance với different parameters: createSelector with resultEqualityCheck.

questions.question: Redux DevTools và time-travel debugging?

options.B: Redux DevTools Extension: xem state tree, action history, time-travel (jump to previous state), import/export state, action replay

questions.explanation: configureStore tự integrate DevTools khi NODE_ENV !== 'production'. DevTools features: (1) Actions log: thấy tất cả dispatched actions theo thứ tự. (2) State diff: xem state thay đổi per action. (3) Time-travel: click action trong history để 'jump' về state đó. (4) Dispatch manual actions từ DevTools. (5) Export/import state. Production: configureStore({ devTools: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' }). Lợi ích debugging: reproduce bugs bằng cách export state + actions, replay.

questions.question: Redux middleware — logger, thunk, custom middleware?

options.B: Middleware: functions that intercept actions before reaching reducer; thunk (default in RTK), logger, custom middleware cho analytics, error reporting

questions.explanation: Middleware signature: (store) => (next) => (action) => { /* intercept */ next(action) }. configureStore({ middleware: (getDefaultMiddleware) => getDefaultMiddleware().concat(logger, analytics) }). Custom: const analyticsMiddleware: Middleware = (store) => (next) => (action) => { if (action.type === 'users/created') { analytics.track('User Created') } return next(action) }. Thunk middleware: enables dispatch(function) hoặc dispatch(async function). RTK Query internal middleware cho polling, cache management. logger: console.log before/after each action for debugging.

questions.question: Implement normalized state với createEntityAdapter?

options.B: createEntityAdapter: manage collections của entities (ids array + entities object); CRUD operations built-in; selectAll/selectById selectors

questions.explanation: const usersAdapter = createEntityAdapter<User>({ selectId: (user) => user.id, sortComparer: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name) }). const usersSlice = createSlice({ name: 'users', initialState: usersAdapter.getInitialState({ loading: false }), reducers: { addUser: usersAdapter.addOne, updateUser: usersAdapter.updateOne, removeUser: usersAdapter.removeOne, setUsers: usersAdapter.setAll }, extraReducers: (builder) => { builder.addCase(fetchUsers.fulfilled, (state, action) => { usersAdapter.setAll(state, action.payload) }) } }). export const { selectAll: selectAllUsers, selectById: selectUserById } = usersAdapter.getSelectors((state: RootState) => state.users). Normalized: { ids: ['1','2'], entities: {'1': {...}, '2': {...}} }.

questions.question: RTK Query với authentication headers và token refresh?

options.B: prepareHeaders trong baseQuery để inject auth token; re-authQuery pattern cho token refresh; conditional fetching với skip

questions.explanation: const baseQuery = fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: '/api', prepareHeaders: (headers, { getState }) => { const token = (getState() as RootState).auth.token; if (token) headers.set('authorization', `Bearer ${token}`); return headers; } }). Token refresh wrapper: const baseQueryWithReauth: BaseQueryFn = async (args, api, extraOptions) => { let result = await baseQuery(args, api, extraOptions); if (result.error && result.error.status === 401) { const refreshResult = await baseQuery('/auth/refresh', api, extraOptions); if (refreshResult.data) { api.dispatch(setToken(refreshResult.data)); result = await baseQuery(args, api, extraOptions); } else { api.dispatch(logout()) } } return result }. Conditional: useGetUserQuery(userId, { skip: !isLoggedIn }).

questions.question: Redux Persist — persist state trong localStorage?

options.B: redux-persist: persistReducer + persistStore + PersistGate; whitelist/blacklist slices; transforms để encrypt/compress; storage engines
options.D: persist toàn bộ state là best practice

questions.explanation: const persistConfig = { key: 'root', storage: localStorage, whitelist: ['auth', 'preferences'], blacklist: ['api'] // RTK Query cache }. const persistedReducer = persistReducer(persistConfig, rootReducer). const store = configureStore({ reducer: persistedReducer, middleware: (getDefaultMiddleware) => getDefaultMiddleware({ serializableCheck: { ignoredActions: [FLUSH, REHYDRATE, PAUSE, PERSIST, PURGE, REGISTER] } }) }). const persistor = persistStore(store). App: <PersistGate loading={<Spinner />} persistor={persistor}><App /></PersistGate>. Encrypt: redux-persist-transform-encrypt. Compress: redux-persist-transform-compress.

questions.question: Zustand vs Redux Toolkit — khi nào dùng cái nào?

options.B: Zustand: minimal boilerplate, local/feature state, small-medium apps. RTK: enterprise apps, complex state interactions, DevTools, RTK Query, team consistency

questions.explanation: Zustand: const useStore = create((set) => ({ count: 0, increment: () => set((state) => ({ count: state.count + 1 })) })). Component: const { count, increment } = useStore(). Zustand pros: tiny bundle (8kb), no Provider needed, simple API, TypeScript-friendly. RTK pros: DevTools time-travel, RTK Query data fetching, structured patterns for large teams, saga/thunk middleware ecosystem. Choose: Zustand cho feature-specific state, small apps, teams new to Redux. RTK cho existing Redux codebases, enterprise, complex async flows, teams want structure. Both can coexist.

questions.question: Redux action dispatch không thay đổi UI — debug approach?

options.B: DevTools xem action dispatched? Reducer xử lý đúng? Selector select đúng? Component subscribed? Mutable state mutation?

questions.explanation: Debug checklist: (1) DevTools: action có trong log không? Nếu không → dispatch không được gọi. (2) State diff: state có thay đổi không sau action? Nếu không → reducer bug. (3) Mutation: reducer có accidentally mutate existing object không? const newItems = state.items; newItems.push(item) → WRONG, cần spread. RTK Immer cho phép mutation nhưng KHÔNG thể return mutated state và new state cùng lúc. (4) Selector: useSelector(state => state.wrongSlice)? (5) Component: useSelector result thay đổi nhưng component không re-render → component hoặc parent bị memoized.

questions.question: RTK Query cache không invalidate sau mutation — fix?

options.B: tagTypes phải được define trong createApi; mutation phải invalidatesTags; query phải providesTags; tags phải match exactly

questions.explanation: Common issues: (1) tagTypes không declared trong createApi. (2) providesTags và invalidatesTags không match: { type: 'User', id: userId } vs ['User']. (3) Mutation chạy không dispatch invalidation: return type phải correct. Pattern: providesTags: (result) => result ? [...result.map(({ id }) => ({ type: 'User' as const, id })), { type: 'User', id: 'LIST' }] : [{ type: 'User', id: 'LIST' }]. Mutation: invalidatesTags: (result, error, arg) => [{ type: 'User', id: arg.id }, { type: 'User', id: 'LIST' }]. Selective invalidation: chỉ invalidate specific entity vs entire list.

questions.question: Redux performance — too many re-renders với useSelector?

options.B: useSelector re-renders khi reference thay đổi; dùng shallowEqual, createSelector để memoize; tránh creating objects trong selector

questions.explanation: Problem: const { a, b } = useSelector(state => ({ a: state.a, b: state.b })) → new object mỗi render → luôn re-render. Fix 1: Separate selectors: const a = useSelector(state => state.a); const b = useSelector(state => state.b). Fix 2: shallowEqual: useSelector(state => ({ a: state.a, b: state.b }), shallowEqual). Fix 3: createSelector: const selectAandB = createSelector([selectA, selectB], (a, b) => ({ a, b })). React DevTools Profiler → identify components re-rendering unnecessarily. RTK Query: data/isLoading/error are stable references khi cache unchanged.

questions.question: Non-serializable values warning trong Redux?

options.B: Redux state/actions phải serializable (JSON-compatible); Date, Map, Set, Class instances, functions không được — dùng string/number/plain objects
options.C: Class instances có thể store trong Redux

questions.explanation: Warning: 'A non-serializable value was detected in the state'. Redux state phải serializable để: DevTools time-travel, persistence, server-side rendering. Non-serializable: new Date() → store as ISO string. Error instances → store as { message, code }. Map/Set → convert to array. Class instances → store plain POJO. Functions → không store trong state. RTK Query: cache có thể contain non-serializable → serializableCheck.ignoredPaths, ignoredActions. Intentional ignore: getDefaultMiddleware({ serializableCheck: { ignoredActions: ['persist/REHYDRATE'] } }).

questions.question: Large-scale Redux architecture — code splitting, lazy loading?

options.B: store.injectReducer() pattern; Redux dynamic modules; RTK lazy slice registration; separate bundle per feature; redux-dynamic-modules
options.C: Phải load tất cả reducers upfront
options.D: Code splitting không work với Redux

questions.explanation: Dynamic reducer injection: const createRootReducer = (asyncReducers) => combineReducers({ ...staticReducers, ...asyncReducers }). store.injectReducer = (key, asyncReducer) => { store.asyncReducers[key] = asyncReducer; store.replaceReducer(createRootReducer(store.asyncReducers)) }. Lazy load: trong component lazy-loaded: import { usersSlice } from './usersSlice'; useEffect(() => { store.injectReducer('users', usersSlice.reducer) }, []). RTK approach: createSlice kết hợp với dynamic imports. Redux Dynamic Modules library: DynamicModuleLoader component. Code split boundaries: feature → bundle. Shared: auth, app-wide state in initial bundle.

questions.question: Redux với server-side rendering (Next.js)?

options.B: Hydrate server state to client store; createWrapper từ next-redux-wrapper; getServerSideProps dispatch actions; avoid state mismatches
options.C: Tạo store mới cho mỗi request

questions.explanation: next-redux-wrapper: export const makeStore = () => configureStore({ reducer: rootReducer }). export const wrapper = createWrapper(makeStore, { debug: true }). Trong getServerSideProps: export const getServerSideProps = wrapper.getServerSideProps(store => async () => { await store.dispatch(fetchUsers.initiate()); await Promise.all(store.dispatch(apiSlice.util.getRunningQueriesThunk())); return { props: {} } }). _app.tsx: export default wrapper.withRedux(App). Hydration: server state serialized, client store initialized with same state → no mismatch. Critical: store per request (không share giữa requests → security issue).

questions.question: Redux testing — unit tests cho slices và integration tests?

options.B: Unit test reducers trực tiếp; test selectors với mock state; RTK Query testing với msw; integration tests với renderWithProviders

questions.explanation: Reducer test: describe('counterSlice', () => { it('should handle increment', () => { const initialState = { value: 0 }; expect(counterSlice.reducer(initialState, increment())).toEqual({ value: 1 }) }) }). Selector test: const mockState = { users: { ids: ['1'], entities: { '1': { id: '1', name: 'John' } } } }; expect(selectAllUsers(mockState)).toHaveLength(1). RTK Query + msw: setupServer(rest.get('/api/users', (req, res, ctx) => res(ctx.json([...])))); await server.listen(). renderWithProviders helper: function renderWithProviders(ui, { store = setupStore() }) { return render(<Provider store={store}>{ui}</Provider>) }. Integration: dispatch actions → verify state → verify UI.

questions.question: Redux vs Zustand vs Jotai vs Context API — khi nào dùng gì?

options.A: Redux là tốt nhất cho mọi trường hợp
options.B: Context: simple auth/theme. Zustand: feature state, medium apps. Jotai/Recoil: atomic state, fine-grained. RTK: enterprise, complex async, team standard, DevTools
options.C: Context API có thể replace tất cả

questions.explanation: Decision matrix: Context API: simple low-frequency state (theme, auth, language). Không cho high-frequency updates (performance). Zustand: medium complexity, small bundle (8kb), minimal boilerplate, feature modules. Jotai/Recoil: atomic state, component-level subscriptions, derived state graph. RTK/Redux: enterprise apps, existing Redux codebase, need DevTools, complex async (RTK Query), large team needs consistency. Bundle size: Context (0kb) < Zustand (8kb) < Jotai (13kb) < Redux Toolkit (40kb). Mix: RTK cho global shared state + Zustand cho feature state + Context cho simple config.
